description.zh: 视频游戏（玩法优先）蓝图编辑器与运行时 · 演出节点图 + Boss 战 / 血条 / QTE 闯关 / 限时·暂停选择 / 可点热点，新引擎 GameGraph 为唯一 SSOT
description.en: Video-game (gameplay-on-video) blueprint editor & runtime — a graph of performance nodes with boss battles, HP bars, QTE, timed/pause choices, clickable hotspots. The GameGraph engine is the single source of truth.

description.zh: 读取当前 game 的 GameGraph 蓝图（演出节点图 scenarios.graph.json）；无盘数据时回退内置 demo。改图前先调它拿现有 nodes/edges。
description.en: Read the current game's GameGraph blueprint (scenarios.graph.json, a graph of performance nodes); falls back to the built-in demo when no disk data. Call before editing to get existing nodes/edges.

description.zh: 整本覆盖写当前 game 的 GameGraph 蓝图并压一版快照（留10）。落盘前做结构校验（节点 id 唯一、边 source/target 指向存在节点），有 error 则拒绝。典型：get-graph → 改 nodes/edges（加节点、把 A→B 的连线改成 A→C、折条件到出边）→ save-graph。
description.en: Whole-document overwrite of the current game's GameGraph blueprint plus a version snapshot (keeps 10). Structurally validated before write (unique node ids, edges reference existing nodes); rejected on errors. Typical: get-graph → edit nodes/edges (add nodes, relink A→B to A→C, fold conditions onto edges) → save-graph.

description.zh: 列出内置演出视频库可用的 media.ref（basename）。编排节点绑视频前先调它看有哪些片段。
description.en: List available built-in performance-video media.ref values (basenames). Call before binding videos to nodes.

description.zh: 第1步·为一个演出节点生成 Seedance V2 镜头脚本（防字幕/一致性/POV 等 prompt IP，纯文本，不落素材层）。生成视频前先拿它作 seedancePrompt。
description.en: Step 1: generate a Seedance V2 shot script for one node (anti-subtitle / consistency / POV prompt IP; text only, no registry write). Get it first as the seedancePrompt before generating video.

description.zh: 第2步·生成一张分镜图/关键帧，落共享素材层。可传 character_ref/scene_ref 作只读参考图、styleAxes 覆盖风格三轴。mode='keyframe'（默认，单帧彩色关键帧→shot_image）或 'grid_storyboard'（6 面板黑白 previs 故事板→grid_storyboard，grid 里可给 nodeRole/endingKind/choiceRevealMoment）。返回 MediaAsset。
description.en: Step 2: generate a keyframe/storyboard image into the shared registry. Pass character_ref/scene_ref as read-only refs and styleAxes to override the 3-axis style. mode='keyframe' (default, single colored keyframe -> shot_image) or 'grid_storyboard' (6-panel B&W previs storyboard -> grid_storyboard; grid.nodeRole/endingKind/choiceRevealMoment steer hard contracts). Returns a MediaAsset.

description.zh: 第3步·为一节点生成一段视频（≤15s 单段），落共享素材层（video_clip）。必传 characterRefIds+sceneRefIds（缺则报错，绝不静默降级）。可传 styleAxes 覆盖三轴、extend+transitionHint 做显式续接。把返回 asset.id 绑到 node.data.media.ref。超长节点用 gen:generate-node-video。
description.en: Step 3: generate one video segment (<=15s) for a node into the shared registry (video_clip). REQUIRES characterRefIds + sceneRefIds (hard error if missing). Optional styleAxes (3-axis override) and extend+transitionHint (explicit continuation). Bind the returned asset.id to node.data.media.ref. For long nodes use gen:generate-node-video.

description.zh: 第3步(超长版)·为一节点生成成片，durationSeconds > 15s 时自动按 15s 拆段，第2段起前置 V-PROMPT-15 延长块 + 首帧续接。必传 character/scene 参考图。返回 assets[]（按段序，单段时长度为1）。
description.en: Step 3 (long-form): generate a node's video; when durationSeconds > 15s it auto-splits into 15s segments, each 2nd+ segment prepends the V-PROMPT-15 extend header + first-frame seam. REQUIRES character/scene refs. Returns assets[] in segment order (length 1 when short).

description.zh: 列出共享素材层的资产（可按 kind/productionType/sceneNodeId 过滤）。挑参考图或查生成产物时用。
description.en: List shared-registry assets (filter by kind/productionType/sceneNodeId). Use to pick reference images or inspect generated outputs.

description.zh: 取单条素材资产（含 status/file/error 等），轮询生成进度或校验绑定用。
description.en: Fetch a single registry asset (status/file/error, etc.) for polling generation progress or verifying a binding.

description.zh: 跨模块只读拿料·把 wb-character 已产出的角色立绘登记成 character_ref（externalPath 指回对方文件，不复制、不改对方目录）。生成视频前先备齐角色参考图。
description.en: Cross-module read-only intake: register wb-character's existing portraits as character_ref (externalPath points back to source files; no copy, no writes to their dir). Call before video generation to stock character references.

description.zh: 跨模块只读拿料·把场景模块发布到 textures/ 的贴图/场景图登记成 scene_ref（externalPath 指回对方文件）。生成视频前先备齐场景参考图。
description.en: Cross-module read-only intake: register scene-module textures published to textures/ as scene_ref (externalPath points back to source files). Call before video generation to stock scene references.
